name: Oscar
source:
He/Him

A rude and often hostile editor from your last job, who has a good reason to dislike you. Reunited by a logistical error, you have a chance to see who he really is.

"Damn, Scribbles, I offer one favor and you drop the name calling just like that? Had I known you were so easy to please…"

[From [url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/titanarum]itch.io[/url]]
